permit.applies: The Immigration and Citizenship Agency processes and issues the permit, verifying the employer and the employment details.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Somalia), Services
sources.said: The Agency processes and issues work permits for foreign nationals employed in Somalia, supporting lawful employment while protecting the domestic labour market.
